verdict.rationale: Statsig ships several domain-specific automations that run unattended once configured. Scheduled Rollouts gradually deploy a feature over time, Autotune shifts traffic toward the winning variant, and alerts catch regressions. The CLI can also be wired into CI/CD pipelines to automate gate and experiment management. However, there is no evidence of a general-purpose or AI-agent-driven background automation or workflow engine; the documented MCP server is interactive question-and-explore access. Missing for 10: a general automation or workflow builder, agent-triggered or scheduled background jobs beyond rollouts and bandits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
